title: Lightly Smoky Egyptian Lamb Kebabs
description: A smoky and springy post-workout Egyptian dish featuring lamb, bok choi, and halal-friendly ingredients, perfect for a quick and healthy dinner
instructions: Preheat grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece
Grill the lamb skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until cooked to an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit
Meanwhile, brush the bok choi with olive oil and season with salt and pepper
Grill the bok choi for 2-3 minutes per side, until slightly charred
Serve the lamb skewers with the grilled bok choi and a side of quinoa or couscous
